snippet.title: SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered - Official Opening Movie Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered opening movie for the RPG remaster. New efatures include enhanced HD watercolor graphics, expanded scenarios and new playable characters in battle. Other features include updated battles with improved pacing, along with newly added game systems and new endgame challenges with powerful bosses. SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered is available now on Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Steam, iOS, and Android.

In SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered, follow Gustave, a royal heir forging his own destiny, and Wil Knights, a fledgling digger pursuing the mystery of the enigmatic Egg—their stories shape the history of Sandail across generations.
